meta.name: add-emacs
meta.description: Add Emacs as a channel. Opens an interactive chat buffer and org-mode integration so you can talk to NanoClaw from within Emacs (Doom, Spacemacs, or vanilla). Local HTTP bridge — no bot token or external service needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在 Emacs 中与 AI 对话，无需外部服务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你用 Emacs 并想直接在编辑器里与 AI 交互
copy.tagline_en: Chat with AI inside Emacs, no external service needed
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Emacs and want to interact with AI directly from your editor

howto.what: 把 Emacs 变成一个对话入口:可在 Emacs 里打开聊天缓冲区直接提问,发送选中的代码或 org 内容后,回复会作为子标题插回 org 文件;markdown 会自动转成 org 格式。
howto.when: 当你说「把 Emacs 加进来」「在 Emacs 里用 NanoClaw」等,或要求配置 Emacs 渠道时触发。

say.text: 帮我看看这个函数哪里有问题
say.note: 在聊天缓冲区提问,回复显示在缓冲区里

say.text: 把选中的段发作代码评审
把这条会议记录整理成行动清单
say.note: 发送 org 条目,返回摘要或待办子节点

howto.what_en: Turns Emacs into a conversation entry point: open a chat buffer inside Emacs to ask questions; send selected code or org content and the reply is inserted as a child heading. Markdown is auto-converted to org-mode.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add Emacs as a channel, e.g. 'add Emacs' or 'use NanoClaw from Emacs', or request setting up the Emacs channel.

say_en.text: Help me find the issue in this function
say_en.note: Reply appears in the chat buffer

say_en.text: Send the selected region for code review
say_en.note: Sent via nanoclaw-org-send; reply appears as a child heading

say_en.text: Turn this meeting note into an action list
say_en.note: Sends the org entry; returns a summary or action-item child node
